# T2/T3/T4: the linker capabilities policy must follow the main module,
# must invalidate the link cache, and must never be read from shared tmp.
# Case A (T2): allow build, flip to deny, rebuild without -a must fail.
# Case B (T3): building dep's main package from a deny main module fails
# even though dep's own logos.toml allows.
# Case C (T4): the -logos.cap path lives outside the shared TMPDIR.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case A: cached link must not survive an allow->deny flip.
# (-o on both builds: a bare build would try to write the output file
# `cmd` over the ./cmd directory; -o still consults the link cache.)
cd a/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/a$GOEXE ./cmd
cp deny-logos.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/a$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
cd ../..

# Case B: dep's own allow logos.toml must not govern a deny main module.
cd b/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/bdep$GOEXE example.com/bdep/cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep/lib'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
cd ../..

# Case C: policy file is action-private, never under shared TMPDIR.
cd c/main
env TMPDIR=$WORK/sharedtmp
mkdir $WORK/sharedtmp
logos build -x -o $WORK/bin/c$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'logos\.cap='
! stderr 'logos\.cap='$WORK'/sharedtmp'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "allow"

-- a/main/deny-logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/adep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- b/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/bdep/lib"

func main() { lib.Init() }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "allow"

-- b/dep/lib/lib.go --
package lib

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- b/dep/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/bdep/lib"

func main() { lib.Init() }

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "allow"

-- c/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}
